problem.title: Parking Lot System
problem.description: Design a parking lot management system.

classes.name: ParkingLot
classes.responsibility: Manage parking floors and parking operations

classes.name: ParkingFloor
classes.responsibility: Manage parking spots on a floor

classes.name: Vehicle
classes.responsibility: Represent a vehicle entering the parking lot

design.relationships:
ParkingLot HAS-A ParkingFloor
ParkingFloor HAS-A ParkingSpot
ParkingSpot HAS-A Vehicle
design.designDecisions: Use Strategy Pattern for parking spot allocation so different allocation algorithms can be added without modifying ParkingLot.
